BUSINESS STUDIES — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #20
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: BUSINESS STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Entrepreneurship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Entrepreneurship.
   B. Explain Entrepreneurship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Entrepreneurship as rumours only.
   D. Say Entrepreneurship never happens in Kenya.

2. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Explain symbols used on a map
   B. Replace the compass rose
   C. Name the president
   D. Measure rainfall only

3. Which statement about Marketing is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Marketing with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Marketing.
   C. Treat Marketing as rumours only.
   D. Say Marketing never happens in Kenya.

4. Which statement about Public Finance is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Public Finance with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Public Finance.
   C. Say Public Finance never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Public Finance as rumours only.

5. Which statement about Types of Business Ownership is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Types of Business Ownership as rumours only.
   B. Say Types of Business Ownership never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Types of Business Ownership.
   D. Explain Types of Business Ownership with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. Which statement about Savings and Investments is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Savings and Investments never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Savings and Investments with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Savings and Investments as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Savings and Investments.

7. Which statement about The Ledger is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat The Ledger as rumours only.
   B. Say The Ledger never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing The Ledger.
   D. Explain The Ledger with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. Which statement about Methods of Price Determination is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Methods of Price Determination as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Methods of Price Determination.
   C. Say Methods of Price Determination never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Methods of Price Determination with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nairobi
   B. Mombasa
   C. Kisumu
   D. Nakuru

10. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Avoiding all community work
   B. Littering in markets
   C. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   D. Destroying road signs

11. Which statement about Trial Balance is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Trial Balance with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Trial Balance.
   C. Treat Trial Balance as rumours only.
   D. Say Trial Balance never happens in Kenya.

12. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid saving forever
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Hide all money underground
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

13. Which statement about Cash Books is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Cash Books with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Cash Books.
   C. Say Cash Books never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Cash Books as rumours only.

14. Which statement about Consumer and Investor Protection is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Consumer and Investor Protection with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Consumer and Investor Protection never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Consumer and Investor Protection.
   D. Treat Consumer and Investor Protection as rumours only.

15. Which statement about Financial Markets is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Financial Markets never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Financial Markets as rumours only.
   C. Explain Financial Markets with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Financial Markets.

16. Which statement about Procurement is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Procurement with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Procurement never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Procurement.
   D. Treat Procurement as rumours only.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Methods of Price Determination and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Entrepreneurship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Procurement and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Marketing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain The Ledger and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Trial Balance and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Cash Books and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Savings and Investments and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

25. In three clear sentences, explain Financial Markets and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

26. In three clear sentences, explain Public Finance and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
